release_note:
- Security: fixes delegated `users:manage` privilege escalation, gates every tool endpoint, and hardens proxy trust so login rate limiting cannot be bypassed with forged headers.
- New features: adds Rounded Crop and Remove GIF Background, plus Object Eraser lasso and high-quality modes, resize aspect-ratio presets, and two-tier OCR.
- Reliability: fixes iPhone HEIC imports, multi-file PDF conversion presets, stuck downloads, and PostgreSQL/Redis startup and recovery failures.
- Localisation and accessibility: translates the docs, website, and API reference into 21 languages and brings interface contrast to WCAG AA.
